title: Public attention and people-related comments
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe other people noticing, praising, or asking about the vehicle’s appearance, with a few fragments about shared issues or being passed between staff that make the topic somewhat heterogeneous.

positive.summary: Positive reviews highlight strangers and passengers complimenting the car’s exterior, interior, and color, and showing strong interest in seeing it up close.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the reviewer’s problems were echoed by many other people, framing the issue as not isolated.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly mention people admiring or complimenting the car, but some refer to customer-service interactions or being passed between people without enough context to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: Several undetermined fragments sound favorable but do not provide enough context for a reliable sentiment assignment.
The cluster mixes public reactions to the vehicle with separate people-related service interactions, so it is not fully coherent as a single aspect.
One positive fragment concerns profile setup and who rides in the car rather than public admiration, which weakens topical consistency.
